'''Colla sauce''' was a type of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrilan]] sauce. A dish composed of
[[Chandrilan squall tendermeat]] with fresh colla sauce was served in a number of restaurants in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
